# The built-in manual (crates/curl-tool/src/hugehelp.rs, generated by
# gen/manual.py) and `--help <option>`'s search of it
# (crates/curl-tool/src/options/mod.rs).

=== part of the manual is shown
file: crates/curl-tool/src/hugehelp.rs
witness: curl-tool hugehelp::tests::inflates_to_the_generated_text
--- old
    let _ = gzip.decode(GZIPPED, &mut Pieces(each));
--- new
    let _ = gzip.decode(&GZIPPED[..GZIPPED.len() / 2], &mut Pieces(each));

=== an option's text is shown with the newline it was found by
file: crates/curl-tool/src/hugehelp.rs
witness: curl-tool hugehelp::tests::shows_an_option_as_c_does
--- old
                        out(&self.arg[1..]);
--- new
                        out(self.arg);

=== a line longer than C's buffer is shown on
file: crates/curl-tool/src/hugehelp.rs
witness: curl-tool hugehelp::tests::shows_an_option_as_c_does
--- old
                    if self.line_len == self.line.len() {
                        return false;
                    }
--- new
                    if self.line_len == self.line.len() {
                        self.line_len = 0;
                    }

=== `--no-` before an option that is not a boolean is taken
file: crates/curl-tool/src/options/mod.rs
witness: curl-tool options::tests::searches_the_manual_as_c_does
--- old
            Some(name) => find_long(name).filter(|s| s.kind == ArgKind::Bool),
--- new
            Some(name) => find_long(name),

=== the last option's text runs into the description of the files
file: crates/curl-tool/src/options/mod.rs
witness: curl-tool options::tests::searches_the_manual_as_c_does
--- old
    let end: &[u8] = if spec.opt == Opt::Xattr {
--- new
    let end: &[u8] = if false {
